notes: DCA obligation accepted: Resolution 2025-01A (Jan 23 2025). HEFSP filed BER-L-000581-25 on 06/27/2025 (42 pages). Planner: Neglia Group (Anthony Kurus PE PP CME; Lyndsay Knight PP AICP). FSHC settlement signed November 1 (date per HEFSP text) or November 3, 2017. Fourth Round RDP is 4 units. Unmet Need of 170 units addressed via overlay extension (Grove Street Overlay). Present Need addressed by Bergen County Housing Rehabilitation Program.

sites.proposed_zoning: Grove Street Overlay (extension of Affordable Housing Overlay District)
sites.quote: Block 3, Lots 17.02 and 19 shall be included in the Overlay District. In addition, the ordinance shall be amended to allow up to 16 units with a 20% affordable unit set aside for these lots.
sites.notes: Site currently contains Foodies Restaurant (Lot 17.02) and a Two-Family residential dwelling (Lot 19), both owned by Eletherios Sakellaris. Owner has approached Township to develop a multi-family residential dwelling. The 4 RDP credits from this site satisfy the Township's entire Fourth Round RDP obligation. Additionally described at BER-L-000581-25 Pg 21-22: 'Block 3, Lots 17.02 & 19 to be hereafter known as Grove Street Overlay.'
